claim: Deploying across multiple Availability Zones in a Region is part of a high availability strategy and also part of a DR strategy; DR strategies may also use multiple Regions, for example active/passive failover from the active Region to the DR Region.
question: How do Multi-AZ and multi-Region fit into HA and DR?

values.display: Deploying your workload across multiple Availability Zones in an AWS Region is part of a high availability strategy
DR strategies may also make use of multiple AWS Regions

evidence.quote: Deploying your workload across multiple Availability Zones in an AWS Region is part of a high availability strategy designed to protect workloads by isolating issues to one Availability Zone, which uses the redundancy of the other Availability Zones to continue serving requests.

DR strategies may also make use of multiple AWS Regions. For example, in an active/passive configuration, service for the workload fails over from its active Region to its DR Region if the active Region can no longer serve requests.
